scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck:tests: sh -c 'rc=0; tsc -p tsconfig.test.json || rc=1; tsc -p tsconfig.test.workers.json || rc=1; exit $rc'
scripts.typecheck: sh -c 'rc=0; tsc --build || rc=1; tsc -p tsconfig.libs.json || rc=1; pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --filter "./research/**" --if-present run typecheck || rc=1; pnpm run typecheck:tests || rc=1; exit $rc'
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.test: sh -c 'rc=0; pnpm -F @workspace/research-data run test || rc=1; pnpm -C research run test || rc=1; exit $rc'
scripts.dev:apps: PORT=4000 npx tsx artifacts/api-server/src/index.ts & PORT=4003 npx vite dev artifacts/mockup-sandbox --host 0.0.0.0 & API_PROXY_TARGET=http://localhost:4000 PORT=4004 npx vite dev artifacts/research-data --host 0.0.0.0 & wait
scripts.wait-for-services: bash -c 'echo "Waiting for PostgreSQL..." && until docker-compose exec -T postgres pg_isready -U postgres -d mednexus 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done && echo "Waiting for MinIO..." && until curl -sf http://localhost:9000/minio/health/live; do sleep 1; done && echo "Setting up S3 buckets..." && bash scripts/dev-s3-buckets.sh && echo "All services ready!"'
scripts.build:frontend: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && cd artifacts/research-data && BASE_PATH=/ pnpm run build
scripts.deploy:worker: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm -C research exec wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.db:migrate:local: cd research && wrangler d1 execute mednexus-research --local --file=./schema.sql
scripts.d1:migrate: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && cd research && pnpm exec wrangler d1 execute mednexus-research --env production --remote --file=./schema.sql
scripts.d1:migrate:local: cd research && pnpm exec wrangler d1 execute mednexus-research --local --file=./schema.sql
scripts.dev:all: pnpm dev && pnpm run tunnel:run && pnpm run tunnel
scripts.run:all: pnpm run d1:migrate && pnpm run deploy
